info.title: Recall API
info.description: API documentation for the Recall application

post.summary: Registers an OAuth client as an agent of a tenant, with its first grant.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of Agents.

X-Pagination.description: The pagination data for the returned page, as JSON.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary: Adds a permission to the grant of an Agent. The caller must hold the permission.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary: Deletes an Agent. Its client can no longer act in the tenant from the next request.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a single Agent by ID.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary: Removes a permission from the grant of an Agent. The caller needs the manage_agents permission.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary:
Gets one page of audit entries, newest first. With an entityId, it gets the history of that aggregate root and
its children. With no entityId, it gets the entries of the tenant. Needs read_audit_log. A value that the caller
may not read has hidden set and no old or new value. To get the next page, send the nextCursor of this page as
the cursor. The last page has no nextCursor.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary: Adds a Correction of the caller.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of the Corrections of the caller, by term.

X-Pagination.description: The pagination data for the returned page, as JSON.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary: Deletes a Correction of the caller.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a Correction of the caller.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

put.summary: Updates a Correction of the caller.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary: Adds a Person to the directory of the caller.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of the directory of the caller, by name.

X-Pagination.description: The pagination data for the returned page, as JSON.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a Person of the caller.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

put.summary: Renames a Person. Each mention in each Session changes its label, and each text that changes makes a Revision.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary:
Starts a Recording in a Session of the caller, or returns the one that has this client recording ID. The first create
gives 201 and a replay gives 200, so a device can send it again after a lost response.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Lists the Recordings of a Session of the caller. Read one Recording to get its stored slices.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary: Deletes a Recording of the caller and its audio. Text that is saved in the Session stays.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a Recording of the caller, with its status and, when it has no text, the reason.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary:
Ends the upload and queues the work that makes the text. A gap in the slices gives 409, and the slices stay, so a
client can read `storedSlices`, send what is missing, and finish again. A second finish gives the same answer.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Downloads the audio of a Recording of the caller, as an attachment. A range request is allowed.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Says if the work behind all audio runs, and what to do when it does not. The capture page shows this.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary: Queues a Recording that failed or that still waits for its text. It goes on after the text that is saved, so no text repeats.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

put.summary:
Stores one slice of the audio. A repeat with the same bytes gives the same answer, and slices can come in any order.
A slice that has other bytes than the stored one gives 409, because a stored slice does not change.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary:
Adds a Session, or returns the Session that already has this client session ID. The first create gives 201 and a
replay gives 200, so a device can send it again after a lost response. A replay of a deleted Session gives 409.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary:
Gets one page of the timeline of the caller, newest first. To get the next page, send the nextCursor of this page
as the cursor. The last page has no nextCursor.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary: Deletes a Session and each of its Revisions. The sync feed gives each device a tombstone.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a Session of the caller, with its Raw and its Cleaned. The Session of another person gives 404.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets one Cleaned Revision of a Session, with its text.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary:
Gets one page of the Cleaned Revisions of a Session, newest first, with no text. To get the next page, send the
nextCursor of this page as the cursor.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets one Raw Revision of a Session, with its text.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary:
Gets one page of the Raw Revisions of a Session, newest first, with no text. To get the next page, send the
nextCursor of this page as the cursor.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

put.summary: Saves the Cleaned Draft with Last-write-wins on the save time. A save that loses keeps its words as a Revision.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

put.summary: Saves the Raw Draft with Last-write-wins on the save time. A save that loses keeps its words as a Revision.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

put.summary:
Replaces the activity, the moods, and the Topics that the caller chose for a Session. A save from another
`metadataVersion` gets 409 and changes nothing, unless the Session already holds these values. Then the response has the
stored Session, so a retry of a save that reached the server gets 200.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary:
Gets one zip with the log and telemetry files, the version, and the settings with the secrets hidden. Only the Owner
of the install can call this.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary:
Gets the journal rows of the caller that changed after the cursor, and a tombstone for each row that is gone. Send
no cursor for the first pull. A 422 means that the cursor came from before a restore of a backup: keep the saves
that did not reach the server, drop the rows that came from the feed, and pull from the start.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.
The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of Tenants.

X-Pagination.description: The pagination data for the returned page, as JSON.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.
The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a single Tenant by ID.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.
The request has no valid access token.

put.summary:
Changes the settings of the caller. A save from another version gets 409 and changes nothing, unless the row already holds
these values. Then the response has the stored settings, so a retry of a save that reached the server gets 200.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets the settings of the caller. A caller with no change yet gets the defaults.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.
The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a paginated list of Users.

X-Pagination.description: The pagination data for the returned page, as JSON.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary: Adds a permission to a User.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.
The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a single User by ID.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.
The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets the signed-in caller from the access token. The caller does not need a user record.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

get.summary: Gets a User by their IDP identifier (sub claim).

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

post.summary:
Creates a new Tenant and User together in a single transaction.
Use this to onboard a new organization with its first admin user.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

delete.summary: Removes a permission from a User.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

put.summary: Updates a User's role. This resets all permissions to the new role's defaults.

401.description: The request has no valid access token.

permissions.description: The grant: the most that the agent can hold.

allowedActions.description: The actions that the caller can send for this agent now. A button in the SPA reads this list.

tenantId.description:
Only for a caller that sees all tenants. That caller must name the tenant. A tenant admin always adds to their
own tenant. If a tenant admin sends a tenant, it must be their own tenant.

clientId.description: The client ID in the tokens of the client. Case-sensitive.

mode.description:
"delegated" for a client that acts for a signed-in user, or "machine" for a client that acts for itself with
client credentials. Only a caller that manages all tenants can add a machine agent.

permissions.description: The first grant. The caller must hold each permission. No permission when it is not sent.

recordId.description: The save that wrote the entry. The entries of one save have the same record id.

ordinal.description: The position of the entry in its save.

action.description: The name of the action, for example "users_exported". Null for a data change.

actorSubject.description:
The `sub` of the token of the save. It shows only to a caller with `read_audit_log_sensitive`,
because a provider can make it an email address. Null for system work.

actorClient.description: The client ID of the token of the save. Null for system work.

actorUserId.description:
The ID of the user who acted, also for a delegated agent. Null for system work, for a client that acts for no
user, and for a user with no user record yet.

actorAgentId.description: The ID of the agent that acted. Null when no agent acted.

requestName.description: The MediatR request of the save, for example "UpdateUser.Command". Null for work outside a request.

items.description: The entries of the page, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Send it as the cursor of the next request to get the next page. Null on the last page.

name.description: The property, for example "FirstName", or "Address.City" for one value of a complex property.

old.description: The value before the change. Null for a created value, for an action, and for a hidden value.

new.description: The value after the change, or the value of an action. Null for a hidden value.

hidden.description:
True when the caller has no `read_audit_log_sensitive` and the value is sensitive, or is a value that the
code no longer knows.

name.description: The display name from the token, or null when the identity provider sends no name.

CurrentUserDto.description: The signed-in caller as the Server sees it in the access token.

baseRevision.description: The Revision that the person edited. It is `0` for a Draft with no Revision.

savedAt.description: When the person saved. A time in the future becomes the time of the server.

outcome.description: A save with the outcome `Lost` did not change the Draft, and its words stay as the newest Revision.

PaginationMetadata.description: The pagination data that a list endpoint sends in the X-Pagination response header.

problemText.description: What happened and what to do, for a person. Null when nothing is wrong.

storedSlices.description: The indexes that are stored, so that a client can send the ones that a broken upload lost.

audioFileName.description: The name for the file route. Null while the upload runs and after the audio is gone.

clientRecordingId.description: The ID that the device made for this Recording. A second create with this ID returns the same Recording.

items.description: The Revisions of the page, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Send it as the cursor of the next request to get the next page. Null on the last page.

length.description: The number of characters of the Revision.

journalingDay.description: The date of DateTimeOffset SessionDto.StartedAt in the time zone of the User. It changes when the time zone changes.

metadataVersion.description: Send it with the next metadata save. A save of a Draft does not change it.

clientSessionId.description: The ID that the device made for this Session. A second create with this ID returns the same Session.

startedAt.description: A time in the future becomes the time of the server.

latitude.description: The server does not store a location when capture is off in the settings of the User.

metadataVersion.description: The `metadataVersion` of the Session that the client read. A save from another version gets 409, unless the Session already holds these values.

items.description: The Sessions of the page, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Send it as the cursor of the next request to get the next page. Null on the last page.

metadataVersion.description: Send it with the next metadata save. A save of a Draft does not change it.

SessionSummaryDto.description: One row of the timeline. It has no Draft, so a page costs the same whatever the length of the text.

cursor.description: Send it as the cursor of the next pull.

hasMore.description: True when a next page already exists, so pull again with no wait.

SyncChangePageDto.description: Each changed row of one page, in its newest state.

SyncTombstoneDto.description: A row that is gone. A device removes its copy, and any local Session with this client session ID.

version.description: The version of the tenant that the caller loaded. A stale version gives 409.

jobsStoppedText.description: What it means and what to do, when the jobs stopped. It names no fault.

TranscriptionStatusDto.description: What a person needs to know about the work behind all audio, whatever the Recording.

allowedActions.description: The actions that the caller can send for this user now. A button in the SPA reads this list.

tenantId.description:
Only for a caller that sees all tenants, such as an allow-listed machine client. That caller must name the tenant.
A user always adds to their own tenant. If a user sends a tenant, it must be their own tenant.

version.description: The version of the user that the caller loaded. A stale version gives 409.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone that gives the Journaling day. Null means UTC. The stored zone is always allowed, also when this host does not know it.

version.description: The `version` of the settings that the client read. A save from another version gets 409, unless the row already holds these values.

timeZoneIsKnown.description: False when this host does not know the stored zone. The Journaling day then comes from UTC until the person sets a zone.
